summary: Completed thorough frontend testing of innerCore landing page (pure static React+Tailwind, no backend). All 18 acceptance criteria verified. Zero console errors. All CTA hrefs (3) point to https://app.innercore.art. All Telegram links (3) point to https://t.me/post_cybercore. Russian Cyrillic renders with EB Garamond serif + Manrope. Dark theme palette correct (#0F1118 bg, #E8E1D4 text). Sphere SVG, DreamMap demo, alchemical sigil cards (Mercurius/Sulphur/Sal ☿🜍🜔), collapsible deep block, fade-in scroll animations (6/6 triggered), and responsive layout (414px mobile + 1440px desktop) all working. critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean, modular and well-structured. App.js (~316 lines), components split into Sphere/DreamMap/Sigils. Uses data-testid extensively. Respects prefers-reduced-motion. No backend dependencies as expected for a pure static landing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure static landing page. Frontend URL: https://dream-map-2.preview.emergentagent.com. All data-testid attributes are intact and reliable. Hero CTA, nav links, deep collapsible, dream map SVG, sphere SVG, footer, fade-in animations all verified. No backend, no auth, no API calls.
